title: Sign-in Security Settings on Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Sign-in security settings

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

## Policy

The holder may change the sign-in email or the two-factor method only while the account status is active. On a tier where two-factor sign-in is required, the holder may not switch two-factor to none, and a recovery that removed it obliges the holder to enrol a new method at the next sign-in before any purchase. Every change is notified to the previous sign-in email where the tier's security notice setting is on. The tier's threshold of consecutive failed sign-ins starts a temporary lockout of the tier's lockout minutes, which does not change the account status and ends by itself; each lockout is recorded on the account history with its start and end moments, and a lockout notice is sent.

| Tier | Two-factor sign-in must stay enabled | Consecutive failed sign-ins that start a lockout | Lockout length (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | No (false) | 10 | 30 |
| Harborline Business Account | No (false) | 10 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | Yes (true) | 10 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | Yes (true) | 10 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | Yes (true) | 10 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | Yes (true) | 10 | 30 |

## Decision table

| Request by the holder | Account status | Tier requires two-factor | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| change the sign-in email | active | either | may be changed; notified to the previous sign-in email |
| switch two-factor to none | active | no | may be changed |
| switch two-factor to none | active | yes | not allowed |
| any change | recovery hold, locked, closed or unverified | either | not allowed |

## Points of judgement

- **Does a temporary lockout lock the account?** No. It does not change the account status and ends by itself after 30 minutes.
- **A recovery on a reseller tier removed two-factor:** the holder must enrol a new method at the next sign-in before any purchase.
